lines.en: : Unbelievable...
: She knows exactly what she’s doing here. She knows what I’m going to think, but it’s like she doesn’t even care.
: Well...she probably doesn’t. This is Nodoka we’re talking about. I’m pretty sure feelings are a thing she doesn’t actually...you know, have.
: How did I get here? I was with Touka just a second ago.
: I assume your legs had something to do with it. I’ve found they’re typically the device that brings me from one place to the other. But that’s probably just because I can’t drive yet.
: You’ve...been with Touka a lot tonight...
: And?
: And...I...uhh...
: I guess...I don’t have anything to...add to that...
: I just...thought it was...a little strange...
: Yeah, we’ve all kind of noticed that. Just no one has really said or done anything about it because pretty much all of us love her and think she’s way out of your league.
: All of you are out of my league but that won’t stop me from having sex with you one day.
: Knock it off! This is hardly the time to joke around like that!
: Um...uhh...I...uhh...
: I don’t...
: There’s no need to respond, Sana. Like Futaba said, that was just a joke. And I don’t intend to have sex with any of you because I’m a good guy and good guys don’t have sex with high school girls.
: What are you doing?
: What do you mean, “What are you doing?”
: I mean what happened to your filter?
: I gave it to Yumi as a birthday present. I figure it will help her from saying anything else that leads to her getting sexually assaulted in locker rooms going forward.
: I said knock it off!
Futaba yells at me. But Futaba never yells at me, so this is probably just a dream. Which means that I should do my rounds again and have sex with everybody before I wake up so no one feels left out.
Now, who’s first?

your lucky number is 46782
do sex ron

your lucky number is 392354
: Sensei, it’s one thing for you to happily dismiss everything Nodoka is doing because you don’t care, but would you maybe consider thinking about those of us that do?
: I feel sick to my stomach that she’d stoop this low all for the sake of...collecting information. And if you’re just going to be mean about it-
: I’m sorry.
: I don’t know what’s happening.
: Well...fine.
: But still, you shouldn’t say things like...that thing you said a minute ago. If one of us took it the wrong way, you could get into a lot of trouble.
: I...I think Sensei...means it when...he says he’s sorry...and...um...
: I won’t...I won’t...tell anyone if...um...
: S...Sorry...it’s just...uhh...it’s...hot in...this costume and...uhh...
: I can’t...I can’t...really...
: I get it now.
: Get what? I don’t think the “joke” was very hard to understand.
: No, I mean I get why he’s been with Touka all night. I’m just...
: I don’t think I can really say any more than that without making him feel worse.
: Stop talking about me like I’m not here. If you have something to say to me, you can say it to my face.
: Sure. I’ll talk all about it while you’re walking me home. Go say goodbye to everyone.
: Home? You’re leaving already?
: I might as well. Otoha’s not here, you’re mad at me, and I want to talk to Sensei for a little while. There’s not really any reason for me to stick around.
: I...don’t think it’s...really necessary to...
: But I don’t want to go home. I want to party.
: Yeah, I get that. You love Halloween and costumes and blah, blah, blah.
: But...Sensei, I really think you might be better off somewhere else right now. This isn’t the...environment you want to be in when things get bad.
: Bad how? There’s nothing bad about being a party animal.
: S...Sensei is right! He should...stay here and...um...we should...keep...uhh...
: He...he should just...stay here...
: Sana, you’re not helping. Leave this to the person here with the most experience in mental breakdowns.
: Is that true, Sensei? Are you actually...going through something like that right now?
: No. I’m fine. I just have a headache. A little water and some rest is all I need. Then, I will be ready to party.
: S...See? He’s fine. He just needs some rest...
: New question — are you doing okay, Sana? Because you’re acting a little strange right now too and I’m starting to think the lack of air in your costume might be messing with your head.
: I...uhh...actually...come to...think of it, it’s...
: It is really hot in here and...I...uhh...I’m not sure...how much...longer I can...
: Uhh...
: Eep!
: Oh my God — Sana?!
: Too...hot...can’t...ngh...can’t...breathe...
: Then take the mask off!
: Never fear. I will save her.
: How do you expect to save anyone in your current state? You can barely even think for yourself right now.
: Th...Thank you...Sensei...
: I think...I...I need to...lie down...
: Woah, what’s going on? What happened? Is Sana okay? I told her she was going to die in that costume.
: This...is it...this is...the end...
: I will not let another girl die.
: We need to take her somewhere cool. Do you have, like...a room we can get her and Sensei some water in? Preferably somewhere we won’t get lost along the way to inside your labyrinth of a house?
: There’s an infirmary down the hall and Geoffrey is a licensed general practitioner. Let me call him and-
: I’ll...be fine with...a little rest...I just...have to lie down and...and change clothes...
: Then let me-
: S...Sensei can...handle it...
: She is right. I have done this before. In the first chapter of the game.
: The...first what?
: You should remember.
: It was special.
: Uhh...
: A...Anyway, the infirmary is the thirteenth door on the left-hand side of the fifth corridor. Just hug the right wall until you see a suit of armor with a cracked helmet and-
: Understood.
: And...you’ll be there in no time at all...
: What the actual fuck is going on right now? Everything was totally fine until, like...ten minutes ago.
: Go with them, please. This feels...weird.
: Me? This is your house. Shouldn’t you be the one to go?
: I have my hands full already. Let’s just say that Sana and Sensei aren’t the only ones acting a little...strange.
: Aaaaaah fine! Sensei, wait up! I don’t want to get lost in Ayane’s house again!
Hug the right wall. Hug the right wall. Hug the right wall. Hug the right wall.
: Sensei! Hold on! You’re walking way too fast!
: Thirteenth door. Left-hand side. Fifth corridor. Hug the right wall.
: Well, I’m glad you remember the instructions because I sure as hell didn’t. But at least let me help you carry her.
: Not needed. She’s light. I could carry ten of her and three of you all at the same time.
: There is no way that is possible, but still! Slow down!
I move my legs toward the place I’m supposed to move my legs toward.
Rin and someone else follow me down the length of the hallway, but I’m too focused on preventing a death to pay either of them any mind apart from responding to their unimportant quips.
Through layers and layers of fabric, I can tell that Sana is burning up. I watch her chest expand and shrink as her lungs take in and exchange air for a prolonged existence.
It’s a reasonable trade. And I hope with every fiber of my shirt that I can continue to make it before being hooked up to a machine that makes all of my trades for me.
This party animal needs no iron lung — just a place to rest my head.
And as I open the thirteenth door on the left-hand side of the fifth corridor, I tell myself a joke.
What’s black and white and red all over?
The severed head of a dairy cow.
I remove a strange costume from the body of a little girl.
Her skin is pale.
Soft, like the casing of a pillow fresh off of the clothesline.
It was sticky from sweat when I made contact with it. I watched her skin cling to my fingertips as if attempting to pull me back in.
There’s a bear on her panties.
I assume she’s had them for a while. I know she hasn’t grown much.
It’s cute, in the kind of way that makes you want to tear something to shreds.
But I abstain.
I am here to protect, not contaminate.
I have long outgrown the bodies of angels.
Besides-
Someone else is watching.
And thievery is quickly cut down while the lights are still on.
: Why is Rin here?!?!?
: So...now what?
: Do we just...wait for her to wake back up?
: You don’t have to stay here if you don’t want to. I can handle her alone.
: Sensei, with all due respect, I’m not sure I trust you to handle anything right now.
: Do you not like me anymore?
: It’s obviously not that, jerk. It’s just-
: Stop staring at Sana’s butt and look at me when I’m talking to you!
: I think you’re, like...dissociating or something.
: It happens to me when I get depressed sometimes. You have to remember where you are and who you are.
: You gravitated to Touka since she’s like a mom, right? You’re feeling vulnerable and weak and so you’ve been clinging to her side because that was the easiest way to keep yourself grounded.
: So, let me ask you this — what can I do? Do you want me to call her? Or will being alone with me for a little while be enough to get your currently-malfunctioning brain to start settling down?
: Everyone seems to be noticing how broken I am today. It’s really demoralizing.
: Probably because everyone loves you, dummy. It’s easy for us to pick up when switches flip inside of your head because we’ve been watching you for years now.
: How many?
: How many what?
: How many years have you been watching me?
: Uhh...is that really important right now?

: Listen...I’m not gonna make you talk because I hate it when people try to do that with me. I just want to know if I can help. So the offer still stands to walk me home once we’re certain Sana is still alive.
: What will we do when we get there?
: Don’t make it weird, Sensei. You know I have a girlfriend.
: Do you ever wonder how things would be if she never showed up?
: Because I do.
: I try not to, but it happens. More than I’d like to admit.
: When I was fucking Nodoka in the room next door to you, I was listening to your voice.
: I was wishing that was me in there. That I was the one you were having your “first sexual experience” with.
: Would that have made you happy?
: Does it matter?
: I don’t know. How do you think I felt listening to Nodoka?
: Probably like you didn’t care.
: Am I wrong?
: Yeah.
: Yeah, you kind of are.
: Rin-
: Are you still thirsty? I saw a vending machine down the hall and Sana’s probably dehydrated from being stuck inside that costume all day.
: I’m sorry for-
: I’ve heard you apologize more times in the last half hour than I have in...practically the rest of my life so far. But it’s fine. I know your head’s not on straight right now.
: I didn’t mean to-
: Are you thirsty or not? I think we both need a little breather right now.
: A water would be nice.
: Okay.
: If I close Sana’s privacy curtain, are you just going to open it back up to stare at her butt again?
: Probably.
: Then I will save myself the effort. Look, but don’t touch. Got it?
: I’m surprised you’re okay with letting me look at all.
: Then you’ve clearly already forgotten who I am.
: I’ll be right back.
: Wow. You trust me even less than I-
